errors.text: The Schmid-factor explanation is backwards: for a fixed critical resolved shear stress, a more favorable (larger) Schmid factor gives a lower axial yield stress. The higher yield stress along the <111>-type direction is associated with its less favorable maximum Schmid factor relative to <110>.
The proposed in-situ HRTEM experiment at strain rates of 10^8-10^10 s^-1 is not realistically executable with conventional in-situ mechanical TEM.
The claimed '1/3{111} stacking fault vector' is incorrectly specified; Shockley partial Burgers vectors are a/6<112>, while diffraction contrast or streaking must be described separately.
